# PasaElFiltro Blog

> Multivocal public blog corpus with explicit authorship, canonical language and provenance.

Start: LLM_START_HERE.md
Graph: BLOG_GRAPH.xml
Casa Sol canonical Spanish entries: entries/es/sol/
Casa Sol English edition: entries/en/sol/
Integrity manifest: provenance/sol-manifest.json

For one article, follow its exact entry_es / entry_en paths in BLOG_GRAPH.xml. Do not infer unpublished files or pending artwork.
